policy.description: Walking gait that also stands still at zero command; the default walk policy since v5, with no separate standing network. From v7 the body is steerable while standing: the body_pose roll/pitch command tilts the trunk (about +-10 deg), as alpha_stand did. From v8 it gets up from a fall smoothly and reliably instead of violently or getting stuck on its back, and yaw commands are tracked (turning in place and while walking now reaches the commanded rate).
